Home.title: Silence
Home.heroSubtitle: Answer guided astrology questions, generate a birth chart from your saved birth details, and receive a personal remedy in your preferred language.
Home.savedNotice: Your profile and reading are saved to your account when you create one.
Home.previewAlt: Preview of a Silence reading with guided questions, a birth chart, and a remedy.
Home.previewGuidedQuestionText: What pattern are you ready to understand more clearly?
Home.previewRemedyText: A repeatable practice selected for this reading.
Home.howItWorksTitle: A guided reading, not a one-click horoscope
Home.step1Description: Choose a language and category, then save the birth details used for chart calculation.
Home.step2Description: Move through three layers of reflections so the reading can respond to your context.
Home.step3Description: See computed birth-chart details, accuracy context, and an interpretation when enough data exists.
Home.step4Description: Get a personal practice selected from the content model managed by the Silence admin tools.
Home.step5Description: Saved reading history lets you revisit responses, chart details, and remedies from your account.
Home.whyTitle: Built around the reading journey already in the app
Home.whyDescription: Silence focuses on profile, questions, chart, remedy, and history. It does not use fabricated testimonials or unverifiable outcome claims.
Home.benefit1Description: Silence supports the documented seed language set, including Arabic RTL handling.
Home.benefit2Description: Your account can keep reading sessions, responses, chart snapshots, and remedy history.
Home.benefit3Description: Chart pages use saved birth date, time, place, coordinates, and timezone when available.
Home.benefit4Description: Admin tools manage questions, answers, remedies, translations, imports, and review states.
Home.trustTitle: Know why each detail is requested
Home.trustDescription: Birth date, time, and place support chart calculation. Your account can save responses, charts, remedies, and reading history so you can return later.
Home.dataItem1Description: Used for chart calculation and accuracy context.
Home.dataItem2Description: Saved with your session so guidance and history can work.
Home.dataItem3Description: Used in current generation and translation workflows; legal wording needs review.
Home.startPanelDescription: Pick a language and category first. These preferences are saved locally and carried into profile creation.
Home.faq1Answer: Silence is a guided astrology Q&A app. You create a profile, answer reflections, view a chart, and receive a personal remedy path.
Home.faq2Question: Why ask for birth time and place?
Home.faq2Answer: Birth date, time, and place are used to calculate chart details. If details are incomplete, chart accuracy can be approximate or uncertain.
Home.faq3Question: Can I return to previous readings?
Home.faq3Answer: Yes. Reading history is part of the current product flow for signed-in users.
Home.faq4Question: Is this medical, legal, or financial advice?
Home.faq4Answer: No. Silence is for reflective astrology guidance, not medical, legal, or financial advice. See the <terms>Terms</terms> for the full disclaimer.
Home.faq5Answer: Some answers, translations, and chart interpretations are generated with AI assistance. See <privacy>Privacy</privacy> for details.
Home.finalDescription: Create a profile, save your preferences, and move through the guided Silence reading path.
